courses.title: Python Programming
courses.summary: Learn Python from first principles, then use it confidently for files, numerical computing, pandas, visualisation and small data projects.
outcomes: Read and write clear Python programs
Use core data structures, functions, files and tests
Work with NumPy, pandas and Matplotlib
Structure a small reproducible Python project

courses.title: Data Analytics
courses.summary: Learn how to frame analytical questions, work in Excel/SQL/Python, clean and reshape tabular data, perform EDA, build visualisations and communicate evidence.
outcomes: Analyse data with Excel, SQL and pandas
Clean, reshape and explore real-world tables
Communicate results with trustworthy visuals and reports

courses.title: Data Science
courses.summary: Build the statistical, computational and experimental skills required to move from exploratory analysis to leakage-safe predictive modelling and interpretation.
outcomes: Interpret uncertainty, errors and model behaviour

courses.title: Machine Learning
courses.summary: Learn how machine-learning algorithms fit, generalise and fail, then practise validation, tuning, calibration, interpretation and production thinking.
outcomes: Explain core ML algorithms and objectives
Build leakage-safe training and validation workflows
Choose metrics and tune models responsibly
Interpret model behaviour and package a final model
